name: proto-blocks/oit-featured-blog
title: OIT Featured Blog
description: Spotlights a single blog post in a two-column layout: date, title, excerpt and a 'Keep Reading' pill on the left, the featured image on the right. Shows the latest published post by default; enter a post ID to feature a specific one.

featuredPost.label: Featured post
featuredPost.help: Leave empty to feature the latest published post automatically. Pick a post from the list to feature it specifically.
